facts.text: The finding by Tal and Wansink (2016) that trivial graphs and formulas increase persuasion failed to replicate in Dragicevic and Jansen (2018); the finding is popular but unreplicated.
facts.quote: The finding that trivial graphs and formulas increase persuasion (Tal and Wansink, 2016) failed to replicate (Dragicevic and Jansen, 2018): popular but unreplicated [206, 45].

facts.text: Bateman and colleagues (2010) found that visual embellishment aided memory without loss of accuracy.
facts.quote: Bateman and colleagues (2010) found visual embellishment aided memory without loss of accuracy [207].

facts.text: Visual decoration should not be used to persuade; visual decoration, if used at all, should aid recall.
facts.quote: Do not decorate to persuade; decorate, if at all, to aid recall.
